mods.name: RSMC: The Third Age
mods.description: Bringing RuneScape to Minecraft, one block at a time!

effect: Black Mask
Blighted Aura
Corruption
Defiler
Infestation
Tainted Shot
While on a slayer task, melee accuracy and power is increased by 15%
While wearing Ahrim's equipment, magic damage lowers the target's strength by 5 levels at a time
While wearing Dharok's equipment, deal more melee damage with lower health
While wearing Guthan's equipment, melee damage heals you
While wearing Karil's equipment, ranged attacks instantly reset the timer
While wearing Torag's equipment, melee attacks steal special attack energy
While wearing Verac's equipment, melee attacks ignore target's protections
Wretched Strength
